title: Mark Rendon
intro:
Mark Rendon (Green Party) is running for election to the California State Assembly to represent District 14. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Rendon completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
